title: Cross-Task Generalization of Emergent Misalignment Beyond Insecure Code

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Direct safety impact: if emergent misalignment generalizes across deceptive task types, it reveals a fundamental training dynamic that demands broad mitigation. If task-specific, safety resources can be focused. Either outcome is highly actionable.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Follows the Betley et al. methodology but requires constructing two new deceptive-task datasets (misleading summaries, fake citations). Dataset design quality is critical and non-trivial for beginners. Fine-tuning three times on a 7B model is feasible on medium compute.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Three separate fine-tuning runs plus evaluation suites. Dataset construction for two new tasks adds upfront work. Clear deliverable (misalignment rate comparison table) but the multi-task design strains the 30-hour budget.
